restaurantName: Lai Cui Mian Guan (Ji Mao Road)
address: 315 Ji Mao Road, Xihu, Hangzhou, China Mainland
bio: For over a decade, this tiny noodle joint has been packed with diners, despite higher prices than its competitors. An array of noodle soups and blanched noodles tossed in sauces are offered with a choice of toppings, all in generous portions and made with quality ingredients. Try the blanched noodles topped with stir-fried pork liver and kidney. Stir the curly hand-rolled noodles in the sauce well and enjoy their springy texture....
pageTitle: Lai Cui Mian Guan (Ji Mao Road)
